turns.text: Good afternoon, Parker Hair Studio. How can I help?

turns.prompt: 你想提出预订或预约需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to make an appointment for a haircut.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to make an appointment for a haircut.
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: Hi, I’m calling to see if you have any appointments available this Saturday.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m calling to see if you have any appointments available this Saturday.
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: I’d like to book a haircut for this weekend, if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to book a haircut for this weekend, if possible.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Do you have anything available Saturday afternoon?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have anything available Saturday afternoon?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

turns.text: We have twelve-fifteen or three-fifty available.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: Sorry, did you say 12:15 or 2:15?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, did you say 12:15 or 2:15?
feedback.explanation: 先说明是在核对理解，再复述关键信息，便于对方纠正听错或记错的细节。

choices.text: Could you repeat the first time, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you repeat the first time, please?
feedback.explanation: “first time”说明是第一次经历这件事，适合回答是否熟悉场所或活动。

choices.text: Sorry, I didn’t quite catch that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I didn’t quite catch that.
feedback.explanation: “Sorry”可用于礼貌打断或引出更正，后面的具体内容让对方知道需要回应哪一点。

choices.text: Let me make sure I heard you correctly: 12:15 or 3:50?

feedback.naturalExpression: Let me make sure I heard you correctly: 12:15 or 3:50?
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

turns.text: That’s right. 12:15 or 3:50.

turns.prompt: 关于「电话综合训练」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ll take the 3:50 appointment, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll take the 3:50 appointment, please.
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: 3:50 works better for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: 3:50 works better for me.
feedback.explanation: “works better for me”表示这个安排更适合自己，表达的是时间或条件上的偏好。

turns.text: Great. Can I have your name?

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Alex Chen. That’s Chen, C-H-E-N.

feedback.naturalExpression: Alex Chen. That’s Chen, C-H-E-N.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: Sure. It’s Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. It’s Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

turns.text: Westside Clinic. How can I help?

turns.prompt: 关于「电话综合训练」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Hi, I’m calling to reschedule an appointment.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m calling to reschedule an appointment.
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: I have an appointment tomorrow, but I need to change the time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have an appointment tomorrow, but I need to change the time.
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: I’m calling about an appointment I have this Friday.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m calling about an appointment I have this Friday.
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: I’d like to cancel my appointment, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to cancel my appointment, please.
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

turns.text: Certainly. Can I have your name and date of birth?
I have you down for Friday at 10:30.

turns.prompt: 你想说明希望将预约调整到更合适的时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s right. Do you have anything later in the day?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s right. Do you have anything later in the day?
feedback.explanation: “that’s right”确认对方复述的信息无误，让对方可以继续办理或安排。

choices.text: Yes, that’s the one I’d like to change.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, that’s the one I’d like to change.
feedback.explanation: “the one”指代前面已谈到的人或物；补充位置或特征，就能区分具体是哪一个。

choices.text: Is there anything available Friday afternoon instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything available Friday afternoon instead?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

turns.text: We have an opening at 3:15.

turns.prompt: 你想从可用时段中选择新的预约时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: 3:15 works for me. Could you move it to that time?

feedback.naturalExpression: 3:15 works for me. Could you move it to that time?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Great. I’ll take that one.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll take that one.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Sorry, was that 3:15 or 3:50?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, was that 3:15 or 3:50?
feedback.explanation: “Sorry”可用于礼貌打断或引出更正，后面的具体内容让对方知道需要回应哪一点。

turns.prompt: 你想核对修改后的预约是否已经确认，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. Just to confirm, I’m now booked for Friday at 3:15?

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Just to confirm, I’m now booked for Friday at 3:15?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Great, I’ve got it. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, I’ve got it. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: C｜客服
scenarios.setting: 玩家打电话询问一笔不认识的收费。

turns.text: Customer support, this is Megan. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 关于「电话综合训练」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Hi, I’m calling about a charge I don’t recognize.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m calling about a charge I don’t recognize.
feedback.explanation: 开头就交代来访或来电目的，帮助对方判断该查询什么、由谁处理。

choices.text: There’s a charge on my account that I’d like to ask about.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a charge on my account that I’d like to ask about.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I think I may have been charged incorrectly.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I may have been charged incorrectly.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Could you help me check a recent transaction?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you help me check a recent transaction?
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

turns.text: Certainly. Can you give me the transaction reference number?

turns.prompt: 你想提供客服需要的订单编号，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. It’s B-74019.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. It’s B-74019.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Give me one second. I have it here somewhere.

feedback.naturalExpression: Give me one second. I have it here somewhere.
feedback.explanation: “one second”是请对方稍等片刻的口语说法，通常不是精确计时。

choices.text: Sorry, could you tell me where I can find that number?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, could you tell me where I can find that number?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: It’s usually listed underneath the transaction.
Okay, I see it. It’s B-74019.
Sorry, was that B-74090?

turns.prompt: 你想澄清客服听错的编号，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, B-74019. One-nine at the end.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, B-74019. One-nine at the end.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Almost. It’s B-74019.

feedback.naturalExpression: Almost. It’s B-74019.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: Let me read it again slowly: B, seven-four-zero-one-nine.

feedback.naturalExpression: Let me read it again slowly: B, seven-four-zero-one-nine.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

turns.text: Got it. Let me look into that for you. Would you mind holding?

turns.prompt: 关于「电话综合训练」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure, I’ll hold.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure, I’ll hold.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: No problem.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: That’s fine. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: D｜酒店前台
scenarios.setting: 玩家已经入住酒店，在房间里给前台打电话。

turns.text: Front desk. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 告诉对方你的房间号，方便对方处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’m calling from room 508.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m calling from room 508.
feedback.explanation: 直接报出房间号，便于前台定位住客、送物或查询记录；无需再重复整个来意。

choices.text: Hi, this is Alex in room 508. I have a quick question.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, this is Alex in room 508. I have a quick question.
feedback.explanation: “this is Alex”电话中常用“This is + 姓名”自报身份。

choices.text: Hello. I’m staying in room 508, and I need some help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hello. I’m staying in room 508, and I need some help.
feedback.explanation: “staying in”指待在家、不外出，适合聊休闲偏好。

turns.text: Of course. What’s the problem?

turns.prompt: 关于「电话综合训练」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: The air conditioning doesn’t seem to be working.

feedback.naturalExpression: The air conditioning doesn’t seem to be working.
feedback.explanation: “doesn't seem to be working”说明设备看起来无法正常运作，保留了进一步检查的余地。

choices.text: I can’t seem to get the air conditioner to turn on.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t seem to get the air conditioner to turn on.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: The room’s getting pretty warm, and I think there’s a problem with the AC.

feedback.naturalExpression: The room’s getting pretty warm, and I think there’s a problem with the AC.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Could someone come up and take a look at it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could someone come up and take a look at it?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

turns.text: Sure. I can send someone up in about fifteen to twenty minutes.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: Sorry, did you say fifteen or fifty minutes?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, did you say fifteen or fifty minutes?
feedback.explanation: 先说明是在核对理解，再复述关键信息，便于对方纠正听错或记错的细节。

choices.text: Could you repeat the time, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you repeat the time, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: So someone should be here within twenty minutes?

feedback.naturalExpression: So someone should be here within twenty minutes?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

turns.text: Yes, within twenty minutes.

turns.prompt: 关于「电话综合训练」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll be in the room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll be in the room.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great, thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: E｜房东 / 维修
scenarios.setting: 玩家发现厨房水槽一直漏水，于是给房东打电话。

turns.text: Hello?

turns.prompt: 你想说明或核对地址，方便对方找到位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, this is Alex from apartment 4B. I’m calling about a problem in the kitchen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, this is Alex from apartment 4B. I’m calling about a problem in the kitchen.
feedback.explanation: 开头就交代来访或来电目的，帮助对方判断该查询什么、由谁处理。

choices.text: Hi, it’s Alex in 4B. The kitchen sink has started leaking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, it’s Alex in 4B. The kitchen sink has started leaking.
feedback.explanation: “leaking”指正在泄漏；用于水管等设备时常指漏水。

choices.text: Sorry to bother you, but I think there’s a problem with the sink.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry to bother you, but I think there’s a problem with the sink.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’m calling because there’s water leaking under the kitchen sink.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m calling because there’s water leaking under the kitchen sink.
feedback.explanation: “leaking”指正在泄漏；用于水管等设备时常指漏水。

turns.text: Is it leaking badly?

turns.prompt: 你想描述遇到的故障并寻求处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s not flooding, but there’s a steady leak.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s not flooding, but there’s a steady leak.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: There’s quite a bit of water under the sink now.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s quite a bit of water under the sink now.
feedback.explanation: “quite a bit”表示相当多或不少，适合口语中描述程度。

choices.text: It’s getting worse, so I think someone should take a look at it soon.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s getting worse, so I think someone should take a look at it soon.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’ve turned the water off for now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve turned the water off for now.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

turns.text: Okay. I’ll call the plumber. He might be able to come by around four-thirty.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: Sorry, did you say the plumber could come around 4:30?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, did you say the plumber could come around 4:30?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Sorry, you cut out for a second. What time did you say?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, you cut out for a second. What time did you say?
feedback.explanation: “cut out”在通话中表示声音断续或中断；是在描述连接问题，而不是评价对方的嗓音。

choices.text: Could you repeat that last part, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you repeat that last part, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: Around 4:30, yes. Will you be home?

turns.prompt: 关于「电话综合训练」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, I’ll be here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’ll be here.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: I should be. Could you ask him to call me before he arrives?

feedback.naturalExpression: I should be. Could you ask him to call me before he arrives?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I won’t be home until five. Is there any chance he could come later?

feedback.naturalExpression: I won’t be home until five. Is there any chance he could come later?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: If I’m not here, please have him call me first.

feedback.naturalExpression: If I’m not here, please have him call me first.
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

turns.text: Sure. I’ll give him your number.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Thanks for arranging that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Thanks for arranging that.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Thanks. Please let me know if the time changes.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Please let me know if the time changes.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。
